title: Desert Billboard Wanderer
description: A lone figure in a yellow firefighter-style uniform with '1435' on the back walks away down a cracked desert highway at dusk. To the right stands a large weathered billboard showing a mirrored scene of the same wanderer in a desolate landscape, illuminated by two spotlights.
prompt: A lone wanderer in yellow protective suit and wide-brimmed hat walks away from viewer on a cracked desert highway at twilight. On the right, a large decaying turquoise billboard displays an identical scene of the wanderer walking through a barren desert, lit by two bright spotlights. Utility poles and old signs line the empty road under a purple and orange sky, cinematic lighting, detailed textures, atmospheric perspective
